How the agents work

One agent finds and reads official pages. Another checks the findings. A Python check confirms that quoted evidence appears in the retrieved text. Both use Composio Connect, without a separate model key.

01 · Find the documentation

349 official pages were found. 347 returned readable text across 94 apps.

02 · Check each finding

Evaluator second pass: 1380 findings checked; 662 supported, 40 contradicted, and 678 inconclusive.

03 · Human review

A person reviewed all 20 claims selected for evidence gaps or agent disagreement.

569 → 300inconclusive checks before → after, out of the same 656 across 82 apps
Page retrieval reduced inconclusive checks by 269. The rate fell from 86.7% to 45.7% (a 41.0 percentage-point drop).
